Bomberman Codes

Every password and secret code for the NES, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Super Nintendo, Genesis, TurboGrafx-16 / PC Engine and Virtual Boy Bomberman games, read from each game's own code and tested in emulators.

    Where these come from

    Each game's password routine was disassembled and rebuilt as a small codec. The generator and checker here run those codecs, and the codes were put through each game's own check in an emulator (Mesen 2 for the NES, Game Boy, Super Nintendo and PC Engine games, BizHawk for Mega Bomberman).

    Addresses, method and screenshots are in the research notes: .
